Orders take 1-2 business days to process before shipping from our warehouse in Dallas, TX (Monday through Friday, excluding major holidays).
Once your order ships, transit times depend on the shipping method selected at checkout (such as 5-7 business days for Priority Ground). You will receive your tracking number via email as soon as the order has been processed and shipped.

menu
Unfortunately, we cannot modify or update the shipping address once an order has been placed, as it immediately enters our warehouse processing system.
If your order has already shipped, you can try reaching out directly to the shipping carrier using your tracking number to see if they offer options to intercept or reroute the delivery.
